entities.name: Rise of the Cabal
entities.description: Event in Cabal City on Otaria in which Virot Maglan became First of the Cabal and killed his family and the Ilyssas.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City on Otaria where the Cabal arose.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land on Dominaria containing Cabal City.

entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: Son of Lady Maglan who gained the power to kill by touch and became First of the Cabal.

entities.name: Lady Maglan
entities.description: Virot's mother who set him upon the Ilyssa family; killed by him.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Dark god who approached Virot in his dreams.

entities.name: Cato Ilyssa
entities.description: Eldest Ilyssa daughter turned to Virot's cause.

entities.name: Ockeed Ilyssa
entities.description: Patriarch of the Ilyssas who was killed.

entities.name: Danske Ilyssa
entities.description: Remaining son of Ockeed forced to convert to the Cabal.

entities.name: Ilyssa family
entities.description: Rival family set upon by the Maglans.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Cult serving Kuberr that filled the city.

events.summary: Kuberr approaches Virot in dreams and grants him the ability to kill upon touch; he rises and dispatches Ilyssa cronies and family.
events.quote: Granted the ability to kill upon touch, he quickly rose to supreme prominence in the city

events.summary: Virot gives up his name and becomes the First of the Cabal.
events.quote: Virot gave up his name and became the First of the Cabal.

events.summary: Virot kills his mother and all his siblings in one fell swoop.
events.quote: killing his mother and all his siblings

events.summary: Ockeed Ilyssa is killed and his son Danske must convert to the Cabal.
events.quote: the Patriarch of their house, Ockeed Ilyssa was killed

events.summary: The whole city fills with Cabal worshippers and arena fighters serving Kuberr.
events.quote: the entire city was filled with Cabal worshippers and arena fighters, all serving the name of Kuberr

relations.quote: Virot dreamt again of Kuberr, who bade him eliminate both family names
